faqs.question: How is a drilling fluid system selected?
faqs.answer: Fluid selection depends on well geometry, formations, temperature, pressure, operational objectives and project economics. A qualified drilling-fluids engineer should review current well data before field use.

faqs.question: Does UniqEnergy support customized fluid programs?
faqs.answer: Yes. UniqEnergy combines specialty chemistry, blending capability and technical experience to develop fluid programs around the needs of each wellbore.

title: Elixir Water-Based Drilling Fluid Lubricant | UniqEnergy
description: Elixir is a concentrated biodegradable lubricant designed to improve water-based drilling fluid lubricity and help manage torque, drag and sticking tendency.

title: Fusion Rheology & Filtration Polymer | UniqEnergy
description: Fusion is a dispersible polymer blend supporting rheology, suspension, hole cleaning and filtrate control in water-based drilling fluids.
h1: Fusion rheology and filtration polymer blend

title: Inertia Interfacial-Tension Reducer | UniqEnergy
description: Inertia is an amphiphilic oilfield treatment designed to reduce interfacial tension and capillary pressure in compatible water, oil and acid systems.

title: UniCide-G15 Oilfield Biocide | UniqEnergy
description: UniCide-G15 is a concentrated glutaraldehyde-based oilfield biocide for broad-spectrum microbial control, including sulfate-reducing bacteria.

title: UniPAC HVD High-Viscosity PAC | UniqEnergy
description: UniPAC HVD is a rapidly hydrating high-viscosity polyanionic cellulose for rheology and filtrate control in water-based drilling fluids.

title: UniPAC LVD Low-Viscosity PAC | UniqEnergy
description: UniPAC LVD is a rapidly hydrating low-viscosity polyanionic cellulose for filtrate control with minimal added viscosity.

title: UniSTOP Lost-Circulation Material | UniqEnergy
description: UniSTOP is a water-swellable synthetic polymer designed to help control severe seepage and lost circulation in high-loss wells.

title: Uniq-RM Clay-Free Invert-Emulsion System | UniqEnergy
description: Uniq-RM is a temperature-stable, clay-free invert-emulsion drilling fluid system supporting rheology, suspension, filtration and lubricity.
h1: Uniq-RM clay-free invert-emulsion drilling fluid system

title: UniSTAR Filtration-Control Additive | UniqEnergy
description: UniSTAR is a modified-starch additive supporting filtration control, encapsulation and borehole stability in water-based fluid systems.

title: ZAN HD Xanthan Biopolymer | UniqEnergy
description: ZAN HD is a highly dispersible xanthan biopolymer designed to develop low-end rheology, suspension and hole-cleaning performance.
h1: ZAN HD highly dispersible xanthan biopolymer

title: SoluBlok Seepage-Loss Material for Oil-Based Fluids | UniqEnergy
description: SoluBlok is a slow-dissolving, oil-absorbing particulate designed to expand and temporarily control seepage in oil-based drilling fluids.

title: EpSealon Removable Fluid-Loss Material | UniqEnergy
description: EpSealon forms an expansive, low-permeability filter cake to help control drilling-fluid losses, with post-drilling washability for productive intervals.

title: KaoloK Kaolinite Fines-Control Treatment | UniqEnergy
description: KaoloK is a formation treatment designed to reduce kaolinite fines migration, limit pore-throat plugging and help protect near-wellbore permeability.
